name: 322. Anthropic server tool request counts in unified usage (anthropic server tool usage)
description: TXE-6534. Anthropic reports usage.server_tool_use.{web_search_requests, web_fetch_requests, code_execution_requests}. Chat and Responses converted to Messages carry each non-zero count as usage.tool_usage.<tool>.num_requests (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution); a count the vendor did not report stays absent. /anthropic/v1/messages passes the vendor body through unchanged, so it needs no case here. The Responses converter drops code_interpreter when web_fetch is present (web_fetch_20250910 does not auto-inject code execution), so Responses checks each tool in its own request.
